paper_goal_alignment.result: The GitHub-only structured frame survives outcome-blind project curation and exact frozen-variable coverage with sufficient independent project clusters for the planned Stata panel design.

execution.workflow: OMOSSP R3 Outcome-Blind Curation + Coverage Gate

operational_project_definition.target_population: Public GitHub OSS software projects represented by one canonical repository in the frozen OSS Compass single-repository candidate frame and passing the prospective R3 metadata curation rules.
inferential_boundary: This operationalization does not imply repository=project universally.
It excludes ambiguous multi-repository/project-boundary cases from the primary frame rather than aggregating them opportunistically.
It does not support software-team or human-only performance inference.

curation_results.primary_frame_policy: Only AUTO_INCLUDE enters formal frame R1. MANUAL_REVIEW cases are held out and are not needed to meet the sample-size requirement.

model_B_conservative_auto_include.note: Conservative field-presence calculation; structural zero-backlog months were not added in R3.

source_version_lock.quantile_semantics: timeDurationConstants.quantileArray=[0,1,2,3,4] and the duration implementation computes quantile(q/4); therefore quantile_2 is the 0.50 quantile/median.
source_version_lock.issue_resolution_semantics: latest/final close among issue lifecycles whose last action is closed
source_version_lock.issue_age_semantics: age distribution of issues open at the evaluation time

sample_size_gate.interpretation: Even the conservative AUTO_INCLUDE-only frame exceeds the preferred cluster target for the primary model; no additional data acquisition is justified for quantity.

supplementation_reopen_only_if: R4 value-level integrity/semantic checks reduce primary Model A project clusters below 500
a frozen R2 construct-critical field proves semantically unusable at scale
formal reproducibility checks reveal systematic source failure
